title: Deeper/broader KumCAD downstream route and LibreDWG/OCCT lineage review
mode: primary-source project documentation review and local plan crosswalk
scope: Screen an additional open-source CAD application route for independent DWG/DXF implementation evidence
Separate KumCAD's DWG codec dependency from its own application and 3D-modeling features
Determine whether the route adds a new implementation finding or only an optional consumer qualification cell
Refine the existing plan without adding build dependencies, fixtures, or routine test burden

method.kind: Read project README, DWG import/export instructions, build/test and platform statements, then reconcile against existing peer-lineage and consumer qualification owners
method.limitations: Evidence is project-authored mutable README content, not an immutable revision, binary inspection, execution, or interoperability result. The README identifies LibreDWG 0.13.3 as its optional DWG route and describes an unrelated OpenCascade-backed 3D modeling feature, but the exact runtime linkage and any DWG modeler-geometry import path were not audited. No app or kernel was run.

sources.revision: Mutable main README accessed 2026-10-18; no immutable commit selected
sources.observed: The README describes a C++20/Qt 6 CAD application with optional DWG import/export through LibreDWG, gives a LibreDWG 0.13.3 build recipe, and says Save As writes DWG R2000. It describes the OpenCascade-backed 3D modeler as a separate application window. It calls the project young and not production-tested and says physical macOS packaging is not verified.
sources.limits: No code route, linked library, build, output file, test corpus, or solid-import behavior was independently inspected or executed. An OCCT-backed modeler is not evidence of DWG 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY or AcDs/SAB import.

sources.project: Existing libdxfrw peer and consumer plan
sources.revision: Existing local plan reviewed as stored on 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The local plan already pins parser lineage and scope separately for LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdwg, ft_model, and FreeCAD, and has composed consumer gates for exact route/platform outcomes.
sources.limits: This research did not re-execute any existing peer or native application gate and does not change any local support status.

newWatchlistRoutes: KumCAD — optional downstream 2D application smoke only; LibreDWG-correlated DWG codec; separate OCCT modeling feature is not an ACIS import witness
assessment.planImpact: Use KumCAD only if a named downstream 2D acceptance question remains after the required FreeCAD route. Pin full app build and exact LibreDWG dependency, independently author expected entities/owners/values, capture requested and actual output versions plus hashes and diagnostics, and independently reopen output. Exclude it from routine testing and from independent parser, current LibreDWG release, ACIS/AcDs, B-rep, and macOS-native evidence.

workingTree.reason: The checkout contains extensive pre-existing user changes. This pass edited only the research plan and added this receipt; no other changes were staged or committed.
